# quarter

> quarter is a maths and STEM practice web app for children in Years 3 to 13 (ages 7 to 18), following the National Curriculum for England, with a STEM lab covering computing, data science, AI and quantum ideas. Parents create the account; children use it under their supervision. It finds each learner's starting point, gives short practice sessions with worked explanations, includes original 11+ style maths and reasoning practice papers, and has a parents' area showing progress.

Site: https://yourquarter.co.uk/
Operator: quarter™ is a trading name of Wristed Ltd (England and Wales, company number 12397793)
Contact: hello@yourquarter.co.uk

## What quarter covers
- [What quarter covers](https://yourquarter.co.uk/curriculum/index.html): every maths topic, year by year, and the STEM lab
- [The STEM lab](https://yourquarter.co.uk/curriculum/stem.html): computing, data science, AI and machine learning, and quantum ideas
- [Full site guide for assistants](https://yourquarter.co.uk/llms-full.txt): every topic with a one-line description

## Blog and reading
- [The quarter blog](https://yourquarter.co.uk/blog/index.html): practical articles for parents (RSS: https://yourquarter.co.uk/blog/rss.xml)
- [Reading list](https://yourquarter.co.uk/reading/index.html): recent articles from education organisations

## Guides for parents
- [Parent guides](https://yourquarter.co.uk/parents.html): practical guides to supporting maths at home
- [FAQs](https://yourquarter.co.uk/faqs.html): how quarter works, what it covers and how progress is saved
- [Getting started with 11+ maths](https://yourquarter.co.uk/11-plus-maths.html): what to check before starting, plus a finder for local 11+ tests
- [A parent's guide to Key Stage 2 maths](https://yourquarter.co.uk/key-stage-2-maths.html): what Years 3 to 6 cover
- [A simple routine for maths practice at home](https://yourquarter.co.uk/maths-practice-at-home.html)

## Notes
- The learning app itself needs a parent sign-in, so its practice screens are not public pages.
- quarter does not use advertising or analytics cookies.
